summary: REGO Electronics Inc. is a Taiwan-based provider of thermal management solutions, offering customized and standard products such as heat sinks, CPU coolers, and vapor chambers. With nearly two decades of experience, they support product development in various sectors, including automation and telecommunications, by addressing thermal design challenges.
